natives.name: PLAYER_PED_ID
natives.description: Returns the ped handle of the local player. Client only; the handle is not valid on the server or for other clients.

natives.name: PLAYER_ID
natives.description: Returns the local player index. This is a client-side index, not the server id.

natives.name: GET_PLAYER_PED
natives.description: Returns the ped handle for a player index. Pass -1 for the local player.

natives.name: GET_PLAYER_SERVER_ID
natives.description: Converts a client-side player index into the server id used by server events and framework lookups.

natives.name: GET_PLAYER_FROM_SERVER_ID
natives.description: Converts a server id into a client-side player index. Returns -1 when the player is not currently known to this client.

natives.name: GET_PLAYER_NAME
natives.description: Returns the display name of a player. On the server the argument is the player source, on the client it is the player index.

natives.name: GET_PLAYERS
natives.description: Returns the list of currently connected player sources. Server only.

natives.name: GET_PLAYER_PING
natives.description: Returns the round-trip latency of a connected player in milliseconds. Server only.

natives.name: GET_ENTITY_COORDS
natives.description: Returns the world position of an entity. The 'alive' flag offsets the position for dead peds; pass false when you only need raw coordinates.

natives.name: GET_ENTITY_HEADING
natives.description: Returns the entity heading in degrees (0-360).

natives.name: SET_ENTITY_COORDS
natives.description: Teleports an entity to the given world position. Only the owning client can move an entity reliably.

natives.name: DOES_ENTITY_EXIST
natives.description: Checks whether an entity handle is still valid. Guard every stored handle with this before use.

natives.name: DELETE_ENTITY
natives.description: Removes an entity from the world. Call this for every entity a resource created in its onResourceStop handler.

natives.name: GET_ENTITY_HEALTH
natives.description: Returns the current health of an entity. Never trust a client-reported value for gameplay decisions.

natives.name: GET_VEHICLE_PED_IS_IN
natives.description: Returns the vehicle a ped is in, or 0 when on foot. Pass true to get the last vehicle the ped used.

natives.name: CREATE_VEHICLE
natives.description: Spawns a vehicle. On the client the model must be requested and loaded first; on the server the model does not need streaming.

natives.name: DELETE_VEHICLE
natives.description: Deletes a vehicle. The calling client must own the entity, otherwise the deletion is not replicated.

natives.name: GET_VEHICLE_NUMBER_PLATE_TEXT
natives.description: Returns the licence plate text of a vehicle. Commonly used as the key for vehicle ownership lookups.

natives.name: SET_VEHICLE_ENGINE_ON
natives.description: Turns a vehicle engine on or off. Set disableAutoStart to true, otherwise the ped restarts the engine on its own.

natives.name: GET_VEHICLE_CLASS
natives.description: Returns the vehicle class index (0 = Compacts, 8 = Motorcycles, 18 = Emergency, ...).

natives.name: CREATE_PED
natives.description: Spawns a ped. Pass isNetwork = false for purely local NPCs so they are not replicated to other clients.

natives.name: REQUEST_MODEL
natives.description: Requests a model to be streamed in. Poll HasModelLoaded with a Wait until it returns true, and bound the wait so a bad model cannot hang the thread.

natives.name: HAS_MODEL_LOADED
natives.description: Returns whether a requested model has finished streaming in.

natives.name: SET_MODEL_AS_NO_LONGER_NEEDED
natives.description: Releases a streamed model so the engine can unload it. Call this right after spawning to avoid leaking streaming memory.

natives.name: GET_HASH_KEY
natives.description: Returns the joaat hash of a string, used for model and weapon identifiers.

natives.name: IS_CONTROL_JUST_RELEASED
natives.description: Returns true on the frame a control was released. Prefer RegisterKeyMapping over polling controls in a loop.

natives.name: SET_NUI_FOCUS
natives.description: Gives or removes input focus for the NUI frame. Always pair a SetNuiFocus(true, true) with a SetNuiFocus(false, false) on every exit path, including errors and onResourceStop.

natives.name: SEND_NUI_MESSAGE
natives.description: Sends a JSON string to the NUI frame, received there via a 'message' event. In Lua use the SendNUIMessage wrapper, which encodes the table for you.

natives.name: REGISTER_NUI_CALLBACK_TYPE
natives.description: Registers an NUI callback name. The Lua RegisterNUICallback wrapper calls this for you; every handler must invoke cb() on every path so the fetch in the UI resolves.

natives.name: NETWORK_GET_NETWORK_ID_FROM_ENTITY
natives.description: Converts a local entity handle into a network id that can be sent to the server or other clients.

natives.name: NETWORK_GET_ENTITY_FROM_NETWORK_ID
natives.description: Resolves a network id back into a local entity handle. Validate the result with DoesEntityExist before using it.
